items.text: For the sample of roadway impact fee assessments selected for testing, we performed the procedures described below for Attributes a through h. The results are summarized below: a. Applicable Fee Schedule – The fee assessed agreed to the City Council-approved roadway impact fee schedule in effect on the assessment date (final plat approval date). b. Development Basis – Supporting permit documentation agreed to the units or square footage used in calculating the roadway impact fee assessment. c. Correct Land Use Classification – The development was classified under the appropriate land use category in accordance with the approved fee schedule. d. Service Area – Documentation supported the assignment of the development to the appropriate roadway impact e. Calculation Accuracy – Recalculation of the assessed fee based on the applicable rate and units/square footage agreed to the amount assessed.
